# GitHub Gist

> > A platform for discovering and sharing code snippets, configuration guides, cheatsheets, and technical documentation through GitHub Gists.

GitHub Gist hosts user-contributed content ranging from command-line cheatsheets and development tutorials to system configuration guides and FAQs. The platform is widely used by developers to share reusable code snippets, reference materials, and step-by-step guides for various technologies including Git, Firefox, Linux, game development, and more.

## Key Topics

- GitHub Gist
- Git version control
- Firefox about:config
- Cheatsheets and reference guides
- Installation and setup guides
- Privacy and security configuration
- Discord server management
- Linux system administration
- Game modding and development
- Development tutorials
- Troubleshooting guides
- Command-line tools
- npm and package management
- Beginner programming resources

## Core Platform

- [Discover gists · GitHub](https://gist.github.com): Homepage for discovering and sharing GitHub Gists code snippets

## Development Tutorials and Learning Resources

- [15-Minute Minecraft Plugin Tutorial For 1.8.8 - 1.21 · GitHub](https://gist.github.com/kangarko/456d9cfce52dc971b93dbbd12a95f43c): Minecraft Bukkit/Spigot plugin development beginner tutorial
